ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Four vials were set up to investigate bacterial transformation. Vials 1 and 2 each contained E. coli bacteria that had been made competent and had then been mixed with a plasmid containing the gene for ampicillin (pAMP) resistance. Vials 3 and 4 both contained E. coli that had also been made competent but had not been mixed with a plasmid. Each vial of bacteria was poured onto a nutrient agar plate. Vials 1 and 3 were poured onto plates that contained the antibiotic ampicillin. Vials 2 and 4 were poured onto plates that did not contain ampicillin.

This figure shows what the nutrient agar plates looked like. The shaded plates represent extensive growth, and the dots represent individual bacterial colonies.

In a variant of this experiment, the plasmid contained GFP (green fluorescent protein) in addition to ampicillin resistance. Which of the following plates would have the highest percentage of bacteria that would fluoresce?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are 4 petri dishes in the figure; on plate 1 there are many scattered individual colony spots; plate 2 is a whole area of shadow-like dense growth; plate 3 has almost no visible growth; plate 4 is also a whole area of shadow-like dense growth. Combined with the question stem, plates 1 and 2 come from bacterial liquid to which the pAMP-containing plasmid was added, and plates 3 and 4 come from bacterial liquid to which no plasmid was added; plates 1 and 3 contain ampicillin, and plates 2 and 4 do not contain ampicillin. In the GFP variant, GFP and the ampicillin-resistance gene are on the same plasmid, so only bacteria that were successfully transformed and carry the plasmid could fluoresce. Plate 1 has ampicillin, and all bacteria that can survive should carry the plasmid, so the proportion of these colonies that fluoresce is the highest, close to 100%. Although plate 2 has growth, it has no antibiotic selection and is mixed with untransformed bacteria, so the proportion that fluoresces is lower. Plate 3 has no plasmid and has antibiotic, so there is almost no growth; plate 4 has no antibiotic but also has no plasmid source, so it also will not have fluorescent bacteria. Therefore, the one with the highest percentage is plate 1.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify plate 1 as containing only a few individual colonies, plate 2 and plate 4 as lawns/extensive growth, and plate 3 as no growth. From the text, map plate 1 to bacteria mixed with plasmid and plated on ampicillin; plate 2 to bacteria mixed with plasmid but no ampicillin; plate 3 to no plasmid with ampicillin; plate 4 to no plasmid without ampicillin. In the GFP variant, GFP is on the same plasmid as ampicillin resistance. On plate 1, ampicillin selects against all non-transformed bacteria, so the colonies that grow are plasmid-containing and fluorescent. Plate 2 includes many non-transformed bacteria because there is no ampicillin selection, and plates 3 and 4 have no plasmid source. Therefore the highest percentage fluorescent is on plate 1 only.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有4个培养皿，1号板上是许多个分散的单个菌落点；2号板是整片阴影状的密集生长；3号板几乎没有可见生长；4号板也是整片阴影状的密集生长。结合题干，1号和2号来自加入了含pAMP质粒的菌液，3号和4号来自未加质粒的菌液；1号和3号含氨苄青霉素，2号和4号不含氨苄青霉素。在GFP变体中，GFP与抗氨苄基因在同一质粒上，所以只有成功转化、带质粒的细菌才可能发荧光。1号板有氨苄青霉素，能存活的菌都应是带质粒的，因此这些菌落中发荧光的比例最高，接近100%。2号板虽然有生长，但没有抗生素筛选，混有未转化细菌，发荧光比例更低。3号板无质粒且有抗生素，几乎无生长；4号板无抗生素但也无质粒来源，因此也不会有荧光细菌。故最高百分比的是1号板。

method.method_draft: Create a plate-by-plate fraction comparison: percentage fluorescent = bacteria with GFP plasmid divided by total bacteria growing on that plate. From the text, only plates 1 and 2 started with bacteria exposed to the plasmid; plates 3 and 4 did not, so their fluorescent fraction is zero or not applicable because they cannot contain GFP plasmid-bearing cells. From the image, plate 2 has extensive growth without ampicillin, meaning its denominator includes both transformed and untransformed bacteria, so less than all of its bacteria would fluoresce. Plate 1 shows only colonies after ampicillin exposure; because those colonies survived ampicillin and the resistance gene is on the same plasmid as GFP in the variant, essentially all growing colonies would be GFP-positive. Thus plate 1 has the highest percentage of fluorescent bacteria.

Thus plate 1 has the highest percentage of fluorescent bacteria.
